critical_conclusions: No new actionable defect was found in the v3 delta. Full-suite execution remains separate evidence.

comparison.scope: v3 response interpretation finally wrapper and DEL-24, with shared cleanup call paths inspected

checked_paths.disposition: Inspected the full final function and wrapper.
Inspected session synchronization, idempotent removal, and unavailable-config fallback.
Inspected malformed relogin return path and current/stale error cleanup.
Inspected preservation controls and DEL-24 assertions.
Confirmed standard-response mapping has no deferred state mutation.

checks.subject: Current response parser failure
checks.conclusion: The finally block removes the completed request even when JSON parsing throws. Other pending configs remain registered.
checks.limit: DEL-24 execution under v3 belongs to the root full-suite result.

checks.subject: Known-config stale response
checks.conclusion: The response guard rejects before credential mutation. Finally calls cleanup, which returns before publishing stale loading.

checks.subject: Known-config canceled response
checks.conclusion: Finally removes only the canceled current request. It preserves other current pending work.

checks.subject: Malformed relogin access
checks.conclusion: errorHandler finishes the config, then finally finishes it again. Set deletion is idempotent and preserves other pending configs.
checks.limit: The extra dispatch can repeat the same boolean. No inspected consumer treats loading dispatch count as behavior.

checks.subject: Standard-response promise
checks.conclusion: Finally runs after the mapping returns its promise. Its executor only resolves or rejects response data. The prior cleanup also preceded promise settlement.

checks.subject: Fresh login epoch replacement
checks.conclusion: Login restamps the response config after invalidation. Cleanup synchronizes the new epoch before deleting the settled login config.

retained_limit.subject: Unavailable config identity
retained_limit.conclusion: The fallback restores prior global cleanup for configless non-cancel errors. It cannot prove request or session ownership.
retained_limit.classification: Known prior semantics, not a new v3 hazard.
